matrix.definition: 2 Chromium profiles (desktop 1280x800; mobile 390x844 DSF3 touch) x 6 mechanisms x 12 scenarios; baseline scenarios x1, stress scenarios x3 with varied params
matrix.pending_reason: firefox + webkit: not installed / not configured in playwright.config.ts (chromium only); reported PENDING, not run
matrix.superseded: First full run: 132/144 cells pass; all 12 fallback-no-blank cells failed with 'Execution context was destroyed' = harness artifact (evaluate awaiting rAF under javaScriptEnabled=false). Harness fixed; 12/12 rerun pass (matrix-fallback-rerun.json). Observation from rerun: without JS + reduced motion, sections are at opacity 0 at load and reach opaque in 138-1311 ms (CSS Hero_heroFade), recorded as msToOpaqueAfterLoad.

UX-P0-001.detail: axe color-contrast violation on .Hero_primaryAction reproduced 1 of 12 timeline runs (1440 viewport, t=0 ms sample, ratio 1.21 #343434 on #414141, effective opacity mid entry-fade). All samples t>=150 ms and rest/hover/focus states: 18.32:1, axe clean. Steady-state NOT reproduced; ledger's 1.05:1 consistent with the same entry-fade window.

UX-P1-006.detail: Lighthouse 13.5.0 mobile x3 on production, medians: Perf 0.92 (PASS >=0.90), LCP 2865 ms (FAIL >2500), TBT 158 ms (PASS), CLS 0 (PASS), A11y/BP/SEO 1.0. Ledger's Perf 71 / TBT 690 NOT reproduced. Loaded 2-vCPU VM; benchmarkIndex ~2700-2900.

UX-P1-001.detail: 320/360/390: scrollWidth == clientWidth at every section, 3/3 repeats each. Hero_opticalField extends past viewport (r=366 at 320) but is clipped, no document overflow.

UX-P2-002.detail: After a nav click to #skills, a scroll with no wheel/key/touch events (scrollbar-drag equivalent, window.scrollTo to Listen, top=0) leaves aria-current and hash on #skills — 3/3 repeats. Controls PASS: click sets aria-current+hash; keyboard PageDown to Listen updates; wheel updates; Back restores #experience; mobile deep link marks #vitrine. Likely cause (hypothesis): pending-anchor lock in components/site/Navigation.tsx released only by user-input events, not by scroll.
